description: The stiff inner foundation around which a worked headband is sewn. A length of vellum strip, dried gut, or glue-stiffened string supplies the body; for large volumes a thick and a thin core can be paired, and a vellum core is sometimes laminated with linen between two layers so it resists hardening and cracking.
name: headband core
